title: Lemon Iced Ambrosia Bars
directions: In med. bowl, combine flour & icing sugar, cut in marg. until crumbly.
Press onto bottom of lightly greased 9x13 pan.
Bake @ 350° for 15 min.
In lg. bowl combine remaining ingred. except icing - mix well.
Spread evenly over baked crust. Bake 20-25 min.
Cool, spread with lemon icing.

title: Ribbon Squares
directions: Crush vanilla wafers, mix with melted margarine. Press into a 9x13" pan. Cook 10 minutes @ 350°. Cool.
Cream cream cheese, add 1/4 cup milk. Make vanilla instant pudding according to directions.
Make Dream Whip & fold into vanilla pudding mixture. Let set.
Mix jello with boiling H2O, stir until dissolved. Stir in strawberries & stir until slightly thick. Let set in fridge.

title: Shortcut Almond Roca
directions: Do not stir.
Remove from heat, add almonds and stir well. Spread on an ungreased cookie sheet.
(Before candy cools sprinkle with 1-6 oz pkg chocolate chips - if desired. As they melt, spread the chocolate evenly over the candy).
Cool in fridge or freezer. Break into bite sized pieces and hide some. Whatever you have disappears.

title: Nabisco Rice Flakes Candy
directions: Combine first 6 ingredients in saucepan - cook and stir until sugar dissolves.
Cook, without stirring, to soft ball stage (240°F).
Cool slightly - add vanilla.
Combine Nabisco Rice Flakes and nuts - pour syrup over cereal mixture - mix well.
Press into buttered 9-inch square pan. Cut into squares when cool.
notes: Cut from a Nabisco Rice Flakes cereal box (yellow package panel)
raw_text:
NABISCO RICE FLAKES CANDY
1/2 cup white sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/3 cup white corn syrup
1/4 cup water
1 teaspoon vinegar
1 teaspoon butter
1/2 teaspoon vanilla
1 box NABISCO RICE FLAKES
1 cup chopped walnuts
Combine first 6 ingredients in sauce-
pan—cook and stir until sugar dis-
solves. Cook, without stirring, to soft
ball stage (240°F). Cool slightly—
add vanilla. Combine NABISCO
RICE FLAKES and nuts—pour syrup
over cereal mixture—mix well. Press
into buttered 9-inch square pan.
Cut into squares when cool.

Remove from heat & add 1/2 tsp. baking soda. Mix well - put on cookie sheet & bake at 200° for 1 hr. Stirring every 15 minutes.
- Add peanuts to popped corn before adding carmel.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
directions: Let eggs & milk sit @ room temperature. (beat now & then)
- heat pan (approx 9 1/2 x 11)
- sift salt & flour into bowl. In separate bowl beat eggs until thick - add milk.
Make hollow in flour mixture - add egg mixture & butter (melted) - beat hard 1 min.
notes: Photo 360 is a duplicate close-up of this same card; the card may continue on its back
raw_text:
Yorkshire Pudding. (Mrs Donaleshen)
7/8 c flour - scant          1 c milk
4 eggs                       2 tbsp. oil from roast.
1/4 tsp. salt.
Let eggs & milk sit @ room temperature. (beat now
& then)
- heat pan (approx 9 1/2 x 11)
- sift salt & flour into bowl. In separate bowl beat
eggs until thick - add milk. Make hollow in flour
mixture - add egg mixture & butter (melted) - beat hard 1 min.
